from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Petitioner)")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of party (e.g., Individual, Company)")

class CourtOrder(BaseModel):
    """A specific order or ruling component."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="Specific order, remedy, or verdict text")

class FeeItem(BaseModel):
    """A fee or monetary item mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The monetary amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency if mentioned (e.g., CNY, CAD)")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee or payment (e.g., Court Fee, Compensation)")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost or receives payment")

class Fact(BaseModel):
    """A specific factual detail."""
    text: str | None = Field(description="The fact or detail text")
    category: str | None = Field(description="Category of fact (e.g., Address, Date, Patent)")

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single legal case extracted from a document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case citation number")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case or procedure (e.g., Civil Appeal, Administrative Review)")
    parties: List[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    procedural_status: str | None = Field(description="Current procedural status (e.g., Appeal, Re-examination)")
    ruling_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the court's disposition")
    orders: List[CourtOrder] = Field(description="Specific orders, remedies, or final rulings")
    fees: List[FeeItem] = Field(description="Court fees and compensation details")
    facts: List[Fact] = Field(description="Key identifying facts (addresses, specific amounts, dates)")
    charges: str | None = Field(description="Criminal charges or specific legal grounds if applicable")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class for the parsed document content."""
    cases: List[CaseRecord]
